evidence.description: JP_BBOX + isJapanGeo + chooseRouter implement C2's deterministic-bbox decision + mixed-endpoint→google fallback exactly as specced.

10-min bucket + uid-scoped cacheKey + TTL-gated getOrCompute implement C3's (uid,from,to,bucket) ≤1-call invariant and moved-event-recomputes semantics; NOT lm_travel_log, matches C3's explicit schema fields (from_geo,to_geo,time_bucket,provider,duration_secs).
planVoice defaults opensLiveWs:false and TTS_ORDER=[edge-tts,kokoro,piper,live] with a null-guard implement C1's cost invariant + fallback + no-silent-call rule.

calendarProviderFilter() is verified (by direct Read, not just the test) to be called at BOTH scheduler.js:43 (supaUsers) and scheduler.js:281 (getUserByUid), inside template literals producing a valid PostgREST `in.()` filter fragment — the exact F4 defect (one site fixed, one left hardcoded) is NOT present.

extractStripeLink + assertMoneyPath do a content assertion (not just 200), and RollbackController implements debounce>=2, flap-guard-via-lastGoodPasses, and one-notify-per-incident exactly as C5/C6 state.
TTL comparison `t - hit.computedAt < ttlMs` is the correct direction (fresh when elapsed < ttl); verified against route-cache.test.js's TTL-expiry test (t += 11min against a 10min ttl → recomputes).

reduce() correctly finds min-arrivalSecs journey (accumulator replaced only when b.arrivalSecs < a.arrivalSecs); manually traced against the committed fixture's 4 journeys (arrivalSecs 84309/84609/84849/88616) → picks 84309/durationSecs=1029, matching the test's asserted value.

Both PostgREST URL template literals correctly interpolate `${calendarProviderFilter()}` inside a backtick string, producing `...&calendar_provider=in.(composio_gcal,pipedream_gcal)`, valid PostgREST `in.()` syntax; no template-literal escaping bug.

RollbackController.onResult's debounce/flap-guard/dedup branches were manually traced against 4 sequences (fail-fail, fail-pass-fail, fail-fail-with-bad-lastGood, fail-fail-fail-fail-recover-fail-fail) and match the money-path.test.js assertions for all sequences the tests actually exercise (see FIND-004 for the untested 3rd-fail extension, which is a coverage gap, not a demonstrated logic error).

The Goal-1 invariant ('default path never opens Live ws') is expressed as a pure, directly-assertable value (opensLiveWs:false) rather than requiring a live GCP billing check — matches the spec's stated verification architecture ('in-process assertion... not GCP billing').

Pure/impure split is clean: HTTP fetch, Netlify restore, and Telegram send are explicitly left to the (not-yet-written) caller, keeping this module unit-testable and formally reason-about-able, consistent with C5/C6's stated architecture.
